Before you set up LIVE
Designed for one creator in a controlled indoor space.
LiveShield protects visible video only. This version captures no microphone audio, so it cannot protect spoken information or background sound.
Visual protection reduces exposure but does not guarantee anonymity.
Do not rely on this version in public venues, moving outdoor scenes, or dense crowds. Those settings have not been validated.
